verdict.rationale: Bruno collections pair runnable requests with per-request docs: there is a rich text docs editor, AI-written docs, and docs can be published as shareable HTML. A README button lets anyone open a collection in Bruno and run the requests, which together approximate an interactive, runnable API reference. However, the published HTML is not shown to be interactive, and Bruno exposes no OpenAPI spec or hosted API reference of its own (probe 404s). Missing for 10: evidence that published docs are interactive or runnable in-browser, a first-party hosted interactive reference, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
